ledgerHost.title: Connect your Ledger
ledgerHost.description: Keep this window open while you connect your device. Your private keys stay on your Ledger.
ledgerHost.start: Unlock your Ledger, then choose Connect Ledger.
ledgerHost.connecting: Choose your Ledger in the device picker.
ledgerHost.ready: Connected. Waiting for your wallet request.
ledgerHost.connectFailed: Could not connect. Unlock your device and try again.
ledgerHost.reviewDevice: Follow the instructions on your Ledger. Verify every detail on its screen.
ledgerHost.complete: Request complete. You can return to Pali.
ledgerHost.busy: Finish the current Ledger request first.
ledgerHost.operationFailed: The Ledger request did not complete. Return to Pali to review or try again.
ledgerHost.unavailable: Open this window from Pali to connect a Ledger.
ledgerHost.disconnected: Disconnected. Return to Pali to connect again.
ledgerHost.warning: This request may use blind signing. Your Ledger may not display every transaction or message detail. Continue only if you understand and trust this exact request.
ledgerHost.footnote: Pali does not send this request to Ledger’s metadata or transaction-checking services. Closing this window cancels pending requests.
